title: Understanding the Loss Function
text: The loss function Jessica designed is a variation of the standard cross-entropy loss. Notice how it includes a term with $$(1-p)$$ raised to the power of $$3$$. Think about how this might affect the loss when $$y$$ is $$0$$ or $$1$$.

title: Exploring the Term $$y \ln\left(p\right)$$
text: In the context of logistic regression, the term $$y \ln\left(p\right)$$ is part of the loss function. Consider what happens to this term when the model predicts class $$0$$ (p is the probability of class 1).
